scoring_justification: Result-level comparison against paper Table 3 using absolute tolerances; no raw simulation data is submitted, so full recompute from trajectories is infeasible, but the verifier effectively 'recomputes' the agreement with the reference properties from the agent's reported CSV.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for Cr-Nb bicrystal tensile properties from Table 3 of the source paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 3 (Elastic and Strength Characteristics of Model Cr–Nb Bicrystals).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values directly extracted from the paper's Table 3; verified to match the reference solve.sh output.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual published results; using them as gold ensures the agent reproduces the original study's quantitative findings.

outputs.description: Derived mechanical properties for Cr-Nb bicrystals pulled along <100>, <110>, <111>. Checker applies tolerances: elongation ±2%, modulus ±10 GPa, strength ±1.5 GPa, work of deformation ±0.1 GJ/m³, and verifies elongation ordering <100> > <110> > <111>.

output_contract.notes: Only the mechanical properties CSV is scored. The simulation engines may be LAMMPS or an equivalent MD code.

steps.description: Compare each mechanical property for all three orientations against paper gold with tolerances
